snippet.title: Dark Stream | Full Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🎥 Go Live. Stay Alive.

A disgraced content creator. A house with a violent past. A livestream that should never have happened.

Dark Stream is a first-person psychological horror investigation game from RedDeer.Games and Skystone Games, coming to PC in 2026.

Chasing views and a comeback, you enter a house rumored to be haunted for decades and begin streaming live. Armed with only your flashlight, your camera equipment, and your instincts, you'll investigate paranormal events, uncover the truth behind the haunting, and survive encounters that react to your every action.

But you're never alone.

Dark Stream features fully integrated Twitch chat, allowing viewers to react in real time to every discovery, every mistake, and every terrifying encounter. They may help you survive, encourage the chaos, or simply spam "F" while everything falls apart.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4028450/Dark_Stream/
